summary: Ran the March report on the issue ledger for all 181 commits from v2.3.0 to v2.4.0 and found the first commit with the 2.4.0 totals (9a04783). Its change to parse_stamp in tally/dates.py converts offsets to UTC, so rows can land in a different booking day. The first tag containing it is v2.4.0rc1.
